summary: Identifies the matching boundary between the carrier terminal path and the primary coupling equipment.
description: Identifies the matching boundary between the carrier terminal path and the primary coupling equipment. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Carrier terminal circuit” at the input and “Matched coupling interface” at the output. Matching and protective functions are equipment-specific.
